#!/bin/bash
# onion-eyes DIAGNOSTIC — environment truth for the cloud-pc route.
set -u
OUT=eyes/diag-result.txt
mkdir -p eyes
exec > >(tee $OUT) 2>&1
echo "== eyes diag $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) pwd=$(pwd) user=$(whoami)"
echo "--- eyes/ dir (store mechanics proof: this script arrived via store)"
ls -la eyes/ 2>&1 | head -20
echo "--- cache SDK tree"
ls $HOME/.cache/cloudpc-models/ 2>&1
ls $HOME/.cache/cloudpc-models/android-sdk/ 2>&1
echo "--- cache system-images"
ls $HOME/.cache/cloudpc-models/android-sdk/system-images/ 2>&1
ls $HOME/.cache/cloudpc-models/android-sdk/system-images/*/ 2>&1 | head
echo "--- sys sdk"
ls /usr/local/lib/android/sdk/ 2>&1
echo "--- java / disk / mem / cpu"
java -version 2>&1 | head -2
df -h . | tail -1; free -m | head -2; nproc
echo "--- sdkmanager installed list (cache sdk, timeout 100)"
timeout 100 /usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$HOME/.cache/cloudpc-models/android-sdk --list_installed 2>&1 | head -30
echo "sdkmanager_list_exit=$?"
echo "--- git"
git log --oneline -2 2>&1 | head -3
git status --short 2>&1 | head -8
echo "== diag end"
REPO=$(cd ../.. && pwd)
cd $REPO
git config user.name "onion-eyes"; git config user.email "eyes@local"
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  git add -A -- cloud-pc/storage/eyes/diag-result.txt 2>/dev/null
  git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null || git commit -q -m "eyes: diag result" 2>/dev/null || true
  git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null
  git rebase -q origin/main 2>/dev/null || { git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; continue; }
  git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null && { echo "diag pushed"; break; }
  sleep 3
done
